purpose: Condition/goal nutrient colour-behaviour rules. Does not define nutrient targets; Nutri AI provides min/max/target values.
global_conflict_policy: Medical safety rules override body-composition goals.
STRICT_AVOID and CLINICIAN_ONLY rules override normal nutrient rules.
If multiple active conditions affect the same nutrient, use the highest override_rank.
Never mark clinically risky nutrients as GREEN just because a body goal needs calories.
Eating-disorder/recovery modes must suppress weight-loss/restriction gamification.

day_progress_model.input: dayProgress = seconds elapsed since user wake/start-of-tracking divided by total planned eating-window seconds, clamped 0.05 to 1.0

TARGET_GOOD.rule: expectedMin = minTarget * dayProgress. RED if current < 0.75*expectedMin; ORANGE if current < 0.95*expectedMin; GREEN if current >= 0.95*expectedMin and current <= maxTarget if max exists. If current > maxTarget, use near_max/over_max colours.

TARGET_GOOD_WITH_UPPER_CAUTION.rule: Same as TARGET_GOOD, but ORANGE near max and RED over max.

RANGE_BALANCED.rule: RED if below paced minimum by a lot or over max; ORANGE if slightly behind pace or near max; GREEN in range.

LIMIT_BAD.rule: GREEN when within safe limit and not trending too fast. ORANGE when current >= 80% daily max OR current > dayProgress*maxTarget*1.15. RED when current > maxTarget.

STRICT_AVOID.rule: GREEN if current == 0 or no exposure. RED for any exposure, unless a tiny trace threshold is explicitly configured.

CUT_ENERGY.rule: Use both min and max. RED if current > maxTarget OR current < 0.70*(minTarget*dayProgress). ORANGE if current > 0.85*maxTarget OR current < 0.95*(minTarget*dayProgress). GREEN otherwise.

BULK_ENERGY.rule: GREEN if current >= 0.95*(target*dayProgress). ORANGE if current is 75-95% of paced target. RED if <75% of paced target. If maxTarget exists and current > maxTarget, ORANGE or RED depending user setting.

RECOVERY_TARGET.rule: Use supportive recovery colours only. RED if behind clinician/user recovery minimum, ORANGE if slightly behind, GREEN if on track. Do not show restrictive 'over calorie' red unless clinician sets hard safety max.

CLINICIAN_ONLY.rule: Apply only when user/clinician has explicitly entered a target/limit. Otherwise show neutral/caution and do not auto-judge.

SYMPTOM_TRIGGER_LIMIT.rule: Only active when the user marks the component as a trigger or is in a relevant elimination phase. Otherwise neutral. If active, use LIMIT_BAD logic.

HYDRATION_TARGET.rule: Use TARGET_GOOD_WITH_UPPER_CAUTION logic; adjust target upstream for sweat/heat/exercise.

LIMIT_BAD.description: Lower/within limit is good; approaching max is warning; over max is bad.

STRICT_AVOID.description: Zero/none is good; any intake is at least warning; over tolerance is red.

TARGET_GOOD.description: Needs to be reached over the day; behind pace is warning; achieved is good.

TARGET_GOOD_WITH_UPPER_CAUTION.description: Needs to be reached, but too much can be bad.

RANGE_BALANCED.description: Too low is bad, middle is good, too high is bad.

CUT_ENERGY.description: Calorie maximum matters, but dangerous under-eating must also become bad by time of day.

BULK_ENERGY.description: Reaching calorie target is good; being behind pace is bad; excessive overshoot can warn.

MAINTAIN_ENERGY.description: Stay inside maintenance range; below or above range is bad.

CLINICIAN_ONLY.description: Only apply when the user/clinician explicitly sets target; show caution, not generic advice.

SYMPTOM_TRIGGER_LIMIT.description: Limit if user marks as trigger; otherwise neutral. Use for IBS, migraine, reflux, etc.

RECOVERY_TARGET.description: Recovery context; avoid restriction framing. Behind target is safety problem; no weight-loss red/green gamification.

HYDRATION_TARGET.description: Hydration/electrolyte target, adjusted by sweat/heat; too low bad, too high can warn.
